verdict.rationale: Jules runs tasks asynchronously in a cloud VM and notifies you when they finish or need input. Tasks can be triggered by adding a "jules" label to a GitHub issue, and the API lets you build custom automated workflows, such as bug fixing and code reviews, with an `automationMode` setting for auto-creating PRs and optional plan approval. Community users confirm PRs arrive while they are away, though some report it needs babysitting or times out on tasks. Missing for 10: scheduled/recurring or event-driven triggers beyond the issue label, documented end-to-end automation setup (`automationMode` values, approval bypass), and independent corroboration of fully unattended runs at scale.
